title: Quick Maths
description: How many math problems can you solve in 60 seconds? Problems start easy and level up to bigger numbers, times tables, and division as your score climbs. Build a streak for bonus time.
howto: Click or tap the right answer, or press 1 to 4 on your keyboard. Wrong answers cost 3 seconds. Every 5 correct in a row adds 2 seconds.

title: Answer Rush
description: A math problem appears at the top, and number bubbles pop up all over the board. Hit the bubble with the right answer as fast as you can. Quick answers score more points, and problems get harder as you go.
howto: Click or tap the bubble with the correct answer. Wrong answers cost 3 seconds. You have 45 seconds.

title: Number Snake
description: Snake with a math twist. The rule at the top tells you which numbers to eat, like multiples of 3. Eat the right numbers to grow, avoid the wrong ones, and watch for the rule to change every few bites.
howto: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, or swipe on a phone. Eating a wrong number costs 3 segments. Hitting a wall or yourself ends the game.

title: Equation Match
description: A memory game where every pair is a math problem and its answer. Flip cards two at a time and match 7 × 8 with 56, 45 ÷ 9 with 5, and so on. Clear all eight pairs in as few moves as you can.
howto: Click or tap a card to flip it, then flip a second one. If one card is a problem and the other is its answer, they stay face-up. Every game deals new problems.

title: Times Table Tower
description: Build the tallest tower you can, one multiplication fact at a time. Every right answer drops a new block onto the stack, but answer wrong or too slowly and the top block tumbles off. The timer gets shorter and the facts get bigger as your tower grows.
howto: Tap or click the right answer, or press 1 to 4. You have 3 lives, and each wrong or late answer costs one.

title: Fraction Pizza
description: Run a pizza shop where every customer orders a fraction. Put pepperoni on exactly the right share of the pizza and serve it before time runs out. Later orders come on pizzas cut into extra slices, so ½ might mean 4 out of 8.
howto: Tap slices to add or remove pepperoni, then press Serve or Enter. Correct pizzas add 2 seconds; wrong ones cost 5.

title: Make the Number
description: You get four numbers and a target. Combine the numbers with +, −, × and ÷ until you land exactly on the target. Every puzzle has at least one solution, and there's often more than one way to get there.
howto: Tap a number, then an operation, then another number to combine them. Keep going until one number is left. Use Undo or Restart if you get stuck, or Skip to try a new puzzle.

title: Balance the Equation
description: Solve linear equations the way a balance scale works: whatever you do to one side, you do to the other. Add, subtract, multiply, or divide both sides until x is alone. Earn up to three stars by solving in the fewest moves, and level up from one-step equations to x on both sides.
howto: Pick an amount with − and + (or keys 1–9), switch between a number and an x-term, then press Add, Subtract, Multiply, or Divide. Undo and Restart are there if you get stuck.

title: Shape Solver
description: Geometry problems with drawings to scale: missing angles in triangles, angles on a line and around a point, area and perimeter of rectangles, the Pythagorean theorem, and circle area and circumference in terms of π. Solve as many as you can in 90 seconds.
howto: Click or tap the right answer, or press 1 to 4. Wrong answers cost 5 seconds.

title: Data Detective
description: Every case is a dot plot of real-world data like hours of sleep or goals per game. Read it and find the mean, median, mode, or range. Wrong answers show a hint so you learn the rule, and the clock keeps ticking.
howto: Click or tap the right answer, or press 1 to 4. You have 90 seconds; wrong answers cost 5 seconds.

title: Derivative Match
description: An intro to derivatives you can see. Look at the graph of f(x) and pick the graph of its derivative, or pick the right derivative formula. Covers polynomials, the power rule, sine, cosine, and eˣ.
howto: Click or tap the matching graph or formula, or press 1 to 4. Hint: where f is going uphill, f′ is positive; where f is flat, f′ is zero.

title: Integer Clash
description: Battle through addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with negative numbers. Numbers get bigger as your streak grows.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Wrong answers cost 5 seconds and show a sign rule to remember.

title: Decimal Dash
description: Race through decimal addition, subtraction, and multiplication, plus multiplying and dividing by 10 and 100.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Wrong answers cost 5 seconds and show a tip.

title: Order Up
description: Evaluate expressions with parentheses, exponents, and mixed operations. The wrong answers include the classic "just go left to right" mistake, so stay sharp.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Remember PEMDAS: parentheses, exponents, multiply/divide, add/subtract.

title: Exponent Express
description: Squares, cubes, powers of 2, 3, 5 and 10, square and cube roots, the zero exponent, and negative exponents.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Wrong answers cost 5 seconds and explain the rule.

title: Prime Time
description: Prime or composite? Decide fast. Watch out for sneaky odd composites like 51, 57, and 91. A wrong answer shows you a factor pair.
howto: Click Prime or Composite, or press 1 or 2. You have 60 seconds.

title: Factor Frenzy
description: Find the greatest common factor or the least common multiple of two numbers, the skills behind simplifying and adding fractions.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Percent Shop
description: Run the register: find percents of numbers, sale prices after a discount, totals with tax, and what percent one number is of another.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Metric Mania
description: Convert between kilometers, meters, centimeters, millimeters, kilograms, grams, liters, and milliliters.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Bigger unit to smaller unit means multiply; smaller to bigger means divide.

title: Number Line Ninja
description: A number appears and you strike where it belongs on the number line: whole numbers, fractions, decimals, negatives, and mixed numbers. The closer your strike, the more points.
howto: Tap or click on the number line. 10 rounds, up to 100 points each.

title: Function Machine
description: Feed numbers into a linear function to find the output, or look at a table of inputs and outputs and figure out the machine's rule.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Slope Spotter
description: A line passes through two points on the grid. Find its slope as rise over run, including negative and fractional slopes.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Coordinate Catch
description: A point appears somewhere on the coordinate plane. Catch it by picking its (x, y) coordinates, in all four quadrants.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Quadratic Quest
description: Factor quadratic equations like x² − 3x + 2 = 0 to find both solutions.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. Look for two numbers that multiply to the last term and add to the middle one.

title: Angle Guesser
description: How big is that angle? Slide to your guess and lock it in. Builds intuition for acute, right, obtuse, straight, and reflex angles.
howto: Drag the slider (or use the arrow keys and ±1/±5 buttons), then press Lock it in. 10 rounds, up to 100 points each.

title: SOH CAH TOA
description: Right-triangle trigonometry: find sin θ, cos θ, or tan θ as a fraction from the side lengths.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4. SOH: opposite/hypotenuse. CAH: adjacent/hypotenuse. TOA: opposite/adjacent.

title: Marble Odds
description: A bag of colored marbles. What is the probability of pulling out a certain color? Give your answer as a simplified fraction.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: End Behavior
description: Read a polynomial and predict its graph: end behavior from the degree and leading coefficient, what happens at each zero based on its multiplicity, turning points, and even or odd functions. Covers AP Precalculus topics 1.4–1.6.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Asymptote Alley
description: Find the vertical asymptotes, horizontal asymptotes, holes, and x-intercepts of rational functions in factored form. Covers AP Precalculus topics 1.7–1.10.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Shift and Stretch
description: A point is on the graph of f. Track where it lands after translations, reflections, and vertical and horizontal dilations like g(x) = 2f(3(x − 1)) + 4. Covers AP Precalculus topic 1.12.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Sequence Sleuth
description: Find common differences and ratios, next terms, and nth terms of arithmetic and geometric sequences, then match tables to linear and exponential functions. Covers AP Precalculus topics 2.1–2.3.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Function Stack
description: Compose functions and run them backwards. Evaluate f(g(x)) and inverse functions from tables and formulas, from f(g(2)) to finding f⁻¹(x). Covers AP Precalculus topics 2.7–2.8.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Log Lab
description: Evaluate logarithms, use the product, quotient, and power properties, and solve exponential and logarithmic equations, including change of base with ln. Covers AP Precalculus topics 2.9–2.13.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Unit Circle Sprint
description: Exact values of sine, cosine, and tangent at special angles on the unit circle, plus radian and degree conversions. Later rounds add negative angles, angles past 2π, secant, and cosecant. Covers AP Precalculus topics 3.2–3.3, 3.8, and 3.11.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Wave Rider
description: Read sine and cosine graphs and equations to find amplitude, midline, period, maximum, minimum, and phase shift. Covers AP Precalculus topics 3.4–3.6.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Polar Points
description: Read points on a polar grid and convert between polar and rectangular coordinates, including negative r values and equivalent angles. Covers AP Precalculus topics 3.13–3.14.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Matrix Mixer
description: Work with 2×2 matrices: determinants, matrix-vector and matrix-matrix products, matrices with no inverse, and matrices that rotate, reflect, and dilate the plane. Covers AP Precalculus topics 4.10–4.13.
howto: Click the right answer or press 1–4.

title: Gate Rush
description: Steer your crowd down the road and pick a gate at every fork: +20, ×2, −15, or ÷3. Choose the one that leaves you with more, dodge red squads, and be bigger than the boss at the end. Levels get longer and the choices get trickier.
howto: Drag left and right, or use the arrow keys or A and D. Space starts the next level.

title: Number Blaster
description: Numbers fall from space, and each wave has a rule: multiples of 6, prime numbers, factors of 36, fractions bigger than ½, and more. Zap the numbers that fit and let the rest fall. Build combos for bonus points.
howto: Click or tap a falling number to zap it. Zapping a wrong number or missing a right one costs a heart.

title: Angle Shot
description: Launch cannonballs over walls, under ceilings, and through gaps to hit every target. Read the protractor to set your angle and power. Wind and moving targets show up in later levels. 14 levels.
howto: Drag from the cannon to aim, then let go to fire. Or use the arrow keys (up and down for angle, left and right for power) and press Space.

title: Function Rider
description: Type an equation and a sled rides your graph from the start line to the flag. Grab the stars and steer around the red blocks using lines, parabolas, absolute value, sine waves, exponentials, and more. 15 levels.
howto: Type an equation after y = and press Ride! or Enter. Use ^ for powers and things like sin(x), sqrt(x), and |x|.

title: Ten Drop
description: Drop numbered tiles into a well and blow up any straight line of tiles that adds up to exactly 10. Falling tiles set off chain reactions, and a new row pushes up from the bottom every few drops.
howto: Tap a column, or use the arrow keys and Space, to drop the next tile. Line up touching tiles across or up and down that add to 10 to pop them. Don't let a column overflow.

title: Number Golf
description: Golf on a number line. Every club does math to your ball: +3, ×2, ÷2 and more. Find the shortest route from the tee to the flag, and steer around the water hazards.
howto: Pick a club (or press 1 to 4) to change your ball's number. Land exactly on the flag. Water costs a stroke. Beat par for a birdie and three stars.

title: Coin Cascade
description: Coins rain from the sky. Catch exactly the right amount of money for each order without going over. Rounds get faster and the targets get bigger.
howto: Move the basket with your mouse, finger, or the arrow keys. Catch coins until your basket equals the target. Going over busts the basket and costs a heart.

title: Prime Defense
description: A tower defense game about prime factors. Number monsters march down the road, and your 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11 towers divide them down. A monster is destroyed when it reaches 1.
howto: Tap a pad to build a tower, then send the wave. A tower only hits monsters its prime divides. Survive all 15 waves.

title: Fraction Slicer
description: Bars fly through the air with a fraction on each one. Slice each bar at exactly that point. Later bars switch to decimals and percents and drop their guide marks.
howto: Swipe through a bar to cut it, measuring from its left end. Closer cuts score more. A bad cut or a missed bar costs a heart.

title: Ratio Mixer
description: Run a paint shop. Every customer wants a color mixed in an exact ratio, and the bucket often already has paint in it. Find the equivalent ratio before your shift ends.
howto: Tap a paint can (or press 1 to 3) to add one part. The order ships when your mix matches the ratio. Use the least paint for a Perfect Mix bonus.

title: Inequality Invaders
description: A space shooter where you only blast the aliens whose number makes the inequality true. Waves move from simple inequalities to two-step and absolute value ones.
howto: Move with the arrow keys or by dragging, and fire with Space or a tap. Hit only solutions. Hitting a wrong alien or getting shot costs a shield.

title: Like Terms 2048
description: Slide algebra tiles around the board. Like terms combine, so 3x and 2x make 5x, but x and x² never mix. Opposites cancel to zero for a big bonus.
howto: Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide every tile. Combine like terms and cancel opposites to keep the board clear. The game ends when nothing can move.

title: Line Launcher
description: Aim a laser using y = mx + b. Set the rise, the run, and the y-intercept so your line passes through every star, and plan around the walls.
howto: Use the + and − buttons to set rise, run and b, then fire. The laser stops at walls. Hit every star in the fewest lines for three stars.

title: Mirror Maze
description: Turn mirrors 15 degrees at a time to bounce a laser into every crystal. The angle marks show the angle in matching the angle out.
howto: Tap a mirror to select it, then tap it again or use the turn buttons to rotate it. Light every crystal at once using as few turns as you can.

title: Fence It
description: Build sheep pens with exactly the right area and exactly the right amount of fence. Every sheep has to be inside, and rocks get in the way.
howto: Drag across the field to paint your pen, and drag from inside it to erase. Match both the area and the perimeter to finish the pen.

title: Tessellate
description: Rotate, reflect, and slide the pieces until they fill the shape with no gaps and no overlaps.
howto: Drag pieces onto the board. Tap a piece to rotate it 90°, and use Flip to reflect it (or press R and F). Fill every square to win.

title: Dice Derby
description: Eleven racers, two dice. Each roll moves the racer whose number matches the sum. Bet on the racers you think will win, and look for good value in the odds.
howto: Tap a lane to bet 10 chips on that racer, then start the race. Odds change every race. Finish 8 races with as many chips as you can.

title: Mean Machine
description: A claw drops number balls onto a balance beam. The beam only balances when the mean of the balls sits exactly on the pivot.
howto: Tap or press Space to drop a ball on the number under the claw. Use every drop to make the mean match the pivot. If it tips, you lose a life.

title: Sample Fishing
description: You can't count every fish in a murky pond. Cast nets to take a sample, then estimate what percent of the whole pond is one color.
howto: Tap the pond to cast a net (5 per pond). Spread your casts out because fish of a color stick together. Then set your estimate and lock it in.

title: Tangent Surfer
description: Surf a curve at night. Keep your board on the tangent line by matching the slope of the wave, its derivative, at every moment.
howto: Move your mouse or finger up and down, or hold ↑ and ↓, to tilt the board. Stay close to the wave's slope to keep your balance. Within 3° scores Perfect points.

title: Riemann Rain
description: Paint rain fills the area under a curve one rectangle at a time. Stop each one at the right height to build an accurate Riemann sum.
howto: Tap or press Space to stop the rising paint. Paint above the curve is spill and empty space below it is a gap. Keep both small across six curves.

title: Slope Field Sailor
description: Ocean currents follow a differential equation. Read the slope field, pick a starting height, and let the current carry your boat into the harbor.
howto: Drag the boat along the dock (or use ↑ ↓), then set sail. The boat follows the solution curve. Reach the harbor and avoid the rocks.

title: Vector Pilot
description: Fly a spaceship by adding vectors. Each turn your thrust is added to your velocity, and your velocity moves the ship. Dock gently at the station.
howto: Pick one of the 9 glowing dots (or press Q W E / A S D / Z X C) to add thrust. Land on the station with a slow speed. Avoid asteroids.

title: Complex Maze
description: Your ship is a complex number. Adding slides it across the complex plane, and multiplying by i spins it around the origin. Reach the star while dodging black holes.
howto: Use the move buttons (or number keys) to change z. Hover a move to preview it. Reach the star in as few moves as you can.

title: Orbit Shot
description: Slingshot a probe around a star. Gravity bends its path into a conic section: a circle, an ellipse, a parabola, or a hyperbola. Thread every ring in one shot.
howto: Drag back and release to launch. Watch the readout for the orbit's type and eccentricity. Fly through every ring and avoid the moons and the sun.
